product.name: Monoprice Commercial Series Heavy-Duty Long Pole Ceiling Mount for Side-by-Side Landscape Displays Fits 34 to 60 TVs
product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series Heavy-Duty Long Pole Ceiling Mount for Side-by-Side Landscape Displays, Fits 34-60in TVsThe Monoprice Commercial Series Heavy-Duty Long Pole Ceiling Mount is designed to suspend two landscape displays side-by-side from a single ceiling drop. It supports 34" to 60" TVs, making it ideal for menu boards, dashboards, and information displays where a wide viewing canvas is required in commercial indoor environments.Horizontal dual-interface design supports two landscape displays side-by-side on a shared ceiling poleEach display supports up to 88 lb (40 kg)Compatible with VESA mounting patterns from 200×200 to 600×400Telescoping pole provides adjustable drop of approximately 50.4" to 74.0"Post-installation tilt (-25° to 0°), level (±3°), swivel (±180°), and rotation (±180°) adjustmentSteel construction for indoor commercial use with professional installation requiredCompliant with REACH, EU POP, TSCA 6(h), and California Prop 65Ideal for menu boards, dashboards, and information displays SIDE-BY-SIDE DUAL-DISPLAY LAYOUTThe horizontal dual-interface design supports two landscape displays mounted side-by-side on a shared ceiling pole, enabling expanded content layouts such as digital menus, scoreboards, or data dashboards from a single mounting point. OPTIMIZED FOR MEDIUM-SIZE COMMERCIAL DISPLAYSEach display supports up to 88 lb (40 kg), suitable for most 34"-60" commercial flat or curved panels. Load ratings are defined in the approved specification and user manual. BROAD VESA COMPATIBILITYCompatible with VESA® mounting patterns from 200×200 to 600×400, ensuring support for a wide range of professional and consumer displays commonly used in signage installations. LONG-POLE DROP FOR CEILING-MOUNTED SIGNAGEThe telescoping pole assembly provides an adjustable ceiling-to-display drop range of approximately 50.4" to 74.0" (1280-1880 mm ±15 mm), accommodating varied ceiling heights in retail and hospitality spaces. POST-INSTALLATION SCREEN ALIGNMENTTilt: -25° to 0°. Level adjustment: ±3°. Swivel: ±180°. Rotation: ±180°. These adjustments help installers correct alignment and optimize viewing angles without dismounting the displays. INDOOR COMMERCIAL CONSTRUCTIONSteel construction is intended for indoor commercial use only. Professional installation and routine inspection are required per the safety guidelines in the user manual. PACKAGE CONTENTS• Ceiling mounting plate• Telescoping steel pole assembly• Side-by-side dual display mounting rails and brackets• Complete mounting hardware kit• Installation manual .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}Lifetime WarrantyWith Monoprice's Lifetime Warranty, you can rest assured we stand behind our products and our customers.
